title: Loop body configuration embedding
statement: Let $body$ and $F$ be finite Boolean-alphabet machines, let $forward$ and $startup$ be Boolean flags, and let $pre$ be a finite Boolean string. Given an input $x$ and a configuration $d$ of the body machine on $x$ with its additional Boolean work tape, the loop body image is a configuration of the loop host on $x$. It maps body states into the host's body-call states, sets the controller phase to $6$ when $startup$ is true and $7$ otherwise, and uses the forward embedding construction when $forward$ is true and the capture construction otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: configuration $d$ of the body machine on $x$ with $body.k+1+(1+F.k)$ work tapes
caveat: The meanings of the forward embedding and capture configuration constructions are not included in the supplied definitions.
